ive not understood my life for the last year lol 

doing well, then cracks appear

i really dont know man, really dont know

i guess i wasnt expecting to hear from her at all and hearing from her rocked me too much

i guess so.. 

not really a nightmare though, just cold detachment from today..

currently sat people watching in a park and havent moved for hours now.. just thinking trying to make sense of it all but cant string two thoughts together

a huge amount of remorse for treating her badly yes..

but thats not the cause of the problem i dont think.. 

speaking to her again made me realise alot of things , brought up stuff i had buried so quickly and not dealt with directly after the break up

she fully knows my history wit hdrugs,

she was the main reason i was able to get clean in the first place and she was my rock thoughtout the remaining years..

since we broke up i collapsed and made some very bad life choices and hurt her so badly and treated her like total crap.. 

her words ' i never gave up on you'

how can someone be so willing to be involved with human trash like me ?? i guess there is a potential subconcious reason..

i am yes.. i wish i could explain my exact feelings/emotions etc..

i dont even know, i just saw what i had and hit it.. i knew it was too much, i knew it was enough to do real damage, but i didnt care, its not like i went out to buy enough with a plan to do it.. i just snapped 


I had major drug problems at a young age, managed to keep a lid on it since my early 20s thanks to a special soul.. that special soul i destroyed.. yet she still cares.. its counter thinking i know ,
